text:
irene: Quick brain-dump: proposing a preflight simulator for config applies that returns a cohort-level breakdown instead of a single aggregate. helps spot small-customer regressions that averages hide.

sam: nice. what does API look like?

irene: POST /configs/preflight with {commit_id, cohorts:["global","enterprise","beta"], sample_seed, validation_hooks:["latency","error_rate","cost"]}. returns preflight_id and a signed report. no state change.

vlad: report format?

irene: signed report contains per-cohort metrics vs baseline: p95/p99 deltas, error delta pp, cost delta per 1k tokens, and a compact cohort_score 0-100. also a small list of flagged routes with reasons. example snippet in the report: 
```
cohort: "enterprise"
cohort_score: 42
flags: ["route:payments - p99 +120ms", "route:search - cost +8%"]
```

sam: must include attribution: which downstream service or variant caused cost spike. otherwise ops chase wrong owner.

irene: yep each flag includes blame: service_id and suggested owner. we surface git_sha and compiled_plan_id in the report header.

vlad: privacy: preflight must not mirror payloads by default. we allow header-only mode plus k-anon sampling. redaction param default=mask.

irene: also want federated validators: teams can register validators (e.g., "payments.validator") that run custom checks in preflight and can emit block/warn votes. preflight aggregates votes and includes them in the signed report.

sam: interesting. validators must be sandboxed. and there should be a way to require unanimous pass for critical validators.

irene: agree. API supports validator_policy per-commit: {required: ["payments.validator"], mode: "warn|block|notify"}. if block and validator fails, preflight returns status=blocked and suggests manual review.

vlad: idempotency: preflight_id = HMAC(commit_id + seed). store sample_seed in ledger so re-fetch is reproducible even if baseline changes.

sam: UI needs quick summary: per-cohort score, top-3 flags, and an expand for per-route micrographs. also a console macro: one-click 'promote-to-preview' that links the preflight to a later /configs/commit with the same sample_seed.

irene: good call. also want a short-lived promotion token: preflight_promo_token that can be used to bind a commit to an operator approval in one click. token logged to ledger.

vlad: security checklist: RBAC scopes configs.preflight, configs.preflight.promote, validators.register. signed reports HMAC_v2, retention 14d. validators run in strict timeout (500ms) and with cpu/mem caps.

sam: testing: need a small harness that can run preflight with synthetic baselines and inject validator failures and small traffic anomalies to ensure cohort breaks are correct.

irene: final nit: add an optional "downstream_attribution=true" flag that runs a lightweight tracing join to map cost spikes to services. default=false because of perf.

vlad: good. can you draft RFC? i'll prototype the signed_report shape and a tiny PoC endpoint that returns deterministic cohort scores.

irene: will do. aiming for RFC tomorrow morning. ops-bot: create checklist item for RBAC + ledger + retention.

ops-bot: checklist created: configs.preflight scope, validator sandbox, signed_report_v2 schema, ledger append on preflight/promo, retention=14d.

irene: thanks all. :smile:
